scope: SlotCache CPU page-to-layer assignment only; not CBT topology, GPU uploads or frame rate
hardware: AMD Ryzen AI 9 H 365 (10 cores, 20 logical CPUs), Linux; optimized Cargo bench profile; no affinity or fixed frequency
baseline: Original Vec-scan implementation from base_commit, measured with the same new benchmark before changing the policy implementation
indexed: Ordered Vec + lookup-only HashMap + HashSet priority dedup + one free/LRU candidate pass sorted by (last_requested,slot); no hash-iteration decisions

scenario.cold: Empty cache preallocated before each sample; request full capacity; all pages uploaded
scenario.churn_1_in_16: Alternate full-capacity request sets sharing 15/16 of IDs; exactly capacity/16 page changes per sample
scenario.included: update_retaining body including its allocations and returned change vector
scenario.excluded: Request construction, empty cache setup/cloning, post-update residency/generation assertions, shader work and GPU traffic
scenario.validation: Expected upload count, generation and complete residency asserted after every sample

limitations: Initial indexed run overlapped a release build of the native app and is retained separately; final run had no overlapping agent build, but neither run used affinity/fixed clocks or controlled OS noise
p99 of 31 samples is the observed maximum, not a stable tail-latency estimate

64-slot warm regression remains in the final run (1382 vs 1022 ns); initial run also regressed cold. Small absolute differences are sensitive to CPU state; expected hashing/allocation overhead can dominate tiny caches
Index and scratch require O(capacity) extra memory; SlotCache clone becomes more expensive; allocation counts, publication clone cost and end-to-end streaming impact are not measured
No StagingBelt A/B, GPU timestamps, submission batching, native perf integration or new buffer allocator in this change
regression_oracle: Original slow policy independently replayed against indexed update/update_retaining at capacities 1,4,64,256 for 240 epochs each; exact changes and slot states compared, clones interleaved, lookup index validated against occupied slots
verification: cargo test -p thessa-rcbt-core --lib; cargo bench -p thessa-rcbt-core --bench material_cache; workspace fmt/clippy/lib+bin/integration and architecture/agent-QA checks also run (see native-environment-radiance-2026-10-17.json)
brutal: Review motivated measurement only. No BRUTAL execution, source copying, dependency or licensing-compatibility claim
